import sys
sys.path.append('storage')

from telos import aos_manager

TICK_TO_LOG = 86

aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    action_type="test_aos",
    target="adapter.py",
    metadata={"eval_id": 202, "status": "failed", "error": "KeyError: 'action_type'"}
)

aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    action_type="log_actions",
    target="tick_85",
    metadata={"eval_id": 203}
)

print("Structured logging complete.")
